name: Salome
bio: Salome was among the women who had followed Jesus from Galilee and ministered to him, and watched his crucifixion from a distance. After the Sabbath, she joined Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James in buying spices to anoint Jesus's body, and went with them to the tomb, where they found it already empty (Mark 15:40-41; 16:1-8).
